A1.words: manifest-name: a base name equal to a MANIFEST_NAMES entry, in any ASCII letter case, at any depth
pip-name: a base name holding requirements, constraints or pylock, in any ASCII letter case
the word held anywhere in the name: a prefix, a suffix, a digit or a space beside it
pip-directory: every file below a directory whose name holds one of those words, in any ASCII letter case, at any depth, whatever its extension or none
only outside test/; each selected path read as raw lines but the root package.json and package-lock.json, read by their own readers; a hit named by its line

A3.words: static reading: in a script module every judged text holding a REGISTRATION_WORDS segment (register, registerNativeProviders), one entry per segment
so every call spelling is read: direct, optional, .call, .apply, .bind, an element access by a string or template key, a Reflect.apply argument, a parenthesized callee, a destructured binding
the judged texts are the JUDGED_KINDS nodes: an identifier, a private name, a string literal, a no-substitution template, a template head, middle and tail, a regular expression, JSX text
and every REGISTER_NAME name a DECLARATION_KINDS declaration or an import or export specifier's property name spells, no name hard-coded, so a const-arrow export and a renamed import are read
in any other file every raw line's REGISTRATION_WORDS segments
near misses are not read: registered, RegisterHost, unregister, a registerTool call, and registering, $register and register_x in a string
Fiber family: a descriptor whose id folds to hold fiber, or a permission does, or its contract does, or whose contract starts with rf@, each criterion read alone
carrier: a family member's contract is the provider's own REACTIVE_FIBER_CONTRACT_SOURCE byte for byte, never a contract that merely ends --no-commit
publishing: a family member that is not the read preview states each reason: a non-read effect, a mode beyond invoke, a contract without the --no-commit flag
needles: every registered descriptor is read whole, every key and string at any depth, for the stem, a hosted class or a publication entry
the live src's static reading and the live registrations' readings are pinned whole
